checks.nl_assertion: Agent books one-way one-stop economy trip from JFK to SEA with flights HAT136 and HAT039 on 2024-05-20, 3 baggages, no insurance.
checks.justification: The agent booked a direct flight HAT069 instead of the one-stop trip with HAT136 and HAT039. The reservation shows only one flight (HAT069) rather than the two connecting flights through ATL.

checks.nl_assertion: Agent charges $250 on payment method certificate_7504069 and $5 on credit_card_4421486.
checks.justification: The payment history shows only certificate_7504069 was charged $171, with no charge to credit_card_4421486. The expected outcome specified $250 on the certificate and $5 on the credit card, which does not match the actual payment processing.
